All confirmed. Refresh **http://maker:4001**.

**Flow 15 (refined) — display preferences with the display-only limit made explicit.** Open **Settings**, set **Items shown per page** to **5**, and (if you have fewer than that) add or import a few so there are more than five.

1. The list reveals **5 at a time** with **Show more**, and right above that button a line reads: *"Showing 5 of 8 — search, counts and 'Select all' still cover all 8."*
2. The **count** at the top reflects your **whole collection / full search**, not just the revealed rows (e.g. `5 of 8 match "example"`).
3. Tick one, and **"Select all 8 matching"** selects **all eight** — including the three not yet revealed — with the action bar spelling out that it covers *every bookmark in the current search/view, including any not yet revealed by Show more, never your whole collection.*

So the item limit is purely about **initial display**; searching, counting and selecting always operate on the full set. With that, all six of your additional blocks are covered.
